puppi: puppis, -is (f.) — stern of a ship (abl. sg., -ī form)

(quae sint ea nūmina) · also exclam. adj., n. acc. pl. (quae bella exhausta canebat!; quae … regna) · also interrog. pron./adj., n. acc. pl., what? (quae quibus anteferam; quae … maiora) · also f. nom. pl. (quae … acies)

(f. acc. sg.: quam arcem?) · also tam … quam, as … as (adv./conj.) · also quam multa … sic, as many as … so · also ante … quam, before (conj., antequam split: non ante … quam)

qui: quī, quae, quod — who, which (rel. pron., m. nom. sg./pl.) · interrog. adj./pron., who? which? (m. nom. sg./pl.: Sed vos qui tandem) · also exclam. adj., what (youths)! (m. nom. pl.: Quī iuvenēs!)

quin: quīn (adv., conj.) — nay more, indeed; why not (introducing an added point)
quo: quī, quae, quod — who, which, what (rel. or interrog., m./n. abl. sg.); quō (adv.), where to · also indef. after nē, any (abl. sg.: nē quō nūmine) · also quō, to what end? why? (quō molem … statuēre?) · also quō (conj.), in order that (quō … averteret)
quod: quī, quae, quod — which (rel., n. nom./acc. sg.); quod (conj.), because, that · also interrog. adj., what? sanguine: sanguis, sanguinis (m.) — blood; descent, lineage (abl. sg.)

scopuli: scopulus, -ī (m.) — rock, crag, cliff (nom. pl.; gen. sg.)
se: suī (reflexive pron.) — himself, herself, itself, themselves (acc.; also abl. sē)
sed: sed (conj.) — but; sed enim, but indeed
sic: sīc (adv.) — so, thus, in this way
sidera: sīdus, sīderis (n.) — star, constellation; pl. the sky (acc./nom. pl.)
simul: simul (adv.) — at the same time, together
socia: socius, -a, -um — allied, friendly, associated (n. acc./nom. pl.; f. nom./abl. sg.)
solioque: solium, -ī (n.) — throne, seat of state (abl. sg.) + -que 'and'

stirpe: stirps, stirpis (f.) — stock, root, lineage (abl. sg.)
sua: suus, -a, -um — his, her, its, their own (f. nom./abl. sg.; n. nom./acc. pl.)
sub: sub (prep.) — + abl. under, beneath; + acc. up to, under

subeunt: subeō, -īre, -iī, -itum — to go under, come up to, approach (3rd pl. pres.)

sunt: sum, esse, fuī — to be; there are; sunt mihi, I have (3rd pl. pres.)

superbus: superbus, -a, -um — proud, haughty, exulting (+ abl.) (m. nom. sg.)
supplex: supplex, supplicis — suppliant, begging humbly (nom. sg.)
supra: suprā (adv., prep. + acc.) — above, over, on top

tibi: tū, tuī — you (sg.); tibi, to/for you (dat.)
tollit: tollō, tollere, sustulī, sublātum — to lift, raise (3rd sg. pres.)

totum: tōtus, -a, -um — whole, entire (m. acc. sg.; n. nom./acc. sg.)

tua: tuus, -a, -um — your, yours (sg. poss.) (f. nom. sg.) · also n. acc. pl. (tua nūmina) · also f. abl. sg. (tua laude)

vertice: vertex, verticis (m.) — peak, summit; whirl (abl. sg.)

vetat: vetō, -āre, vetuī, vetitum — to forbid, prohibit (3rd sg. pres.)

vides: videō, vidēre, vīdī, vīsum — to see, behold (2nd sg. pres.)
